verified_facts.text: SLS Barcelona is set on the marina at Port Fòrum, steps from the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: SLS Barcelona is set on the marina at Port Fòrum, steps from the beach

verified_facts.text: Guests can charter catamarans and private boats from Port Fòrum.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests of SLS Barcelona can charter catamarans and private boats from Port Fòrum

verified_facts.text: A neighbourhood beach is a five-minute stroll from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: A tranquil neighbourhood beach known only to locals and insiders is a five-minute stroll away

verified_facts.text: The Parc del Fòrum, where the Primavera Sound festival is held, is a few steps from the hotel, and the hotel is an official partner of the festival.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Parc del Fòrum, where the popular Primavera Sound festival is held (the hotel is an official partner), is also just a few steps away.

verified_facts.text: The International Barcelona Convention Centre (CCIB) is a short walk from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: with the hotel offering a stylish base only a short walk away

verified_facts.text: Every room and suite has a balcony or terrace, and many have views of the marina and the Mediterranean.
verified_facts.excerpt: The ultimate VIP stay begins with luxe rooms and suites, each featuring a balcony or terrace, many offering views of the marina and the glittering Mediterranean Sea.

verified_facts.text: The Delight King Pool Access room is on the ground floor with direct access to the pool from its patio.
verified_facts.excerpt: This ground floor room provides access to the vibrant SLS pool scene directly from its patio.

verified_facts.text: The Euphoria Apartment has a kitchenette with stove, oven, microwave and mini-fridge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perfect for longer stays, this apartment features a kitchenette with stove, oven, microwave and mini-fridge.

verified_facts.text: The Celestial Suite is the hotel's largest suite and terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: The resort's largest suite and terrace also boast the most breathtaking design and views.

verified_facts.text: A pet kit is available in rooms on request.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pet-Kit (Available Upon Request)

verified_facts.text: The ground-level Coral pool is open year-round, with a boardwalk setting.
verified_facts.excerpt: At ground level, Coral remains open year-round, with its boardwalk setting and laid-back Mediterranean atmosphere.

verified_facts.text: Coral is inspired by the summers of Miami's South Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Coral is inspired by the iconic summers of Miami

verified_facts.text: Coral is a family-friendly pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax by the family-friendly pool, enjoy refreshing drinks and casual dining

verified_facts.text: The two rooftop infinity pools offer sea and city views during the summer season.
verified_facts.excerpt: Two rooftop infinity pools offer panoramic sea and city views during the summer season

verified_facts.text: Halcyon Spa has an immersive jacuzzi where cinematic visuals surround the space and a rain shower falls from above.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cinematic visuals surround the space as jets move through the jacuzzi and a gentle rain shower falls from above

verified_facts.text: Guests who book a spa treatment get 90 minutes of access to the Halcyon facilities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests who have booked a treatment at the spa will enjoy 90 minutes of access to Halcyon facilities

verified_facts.text: The Halcyon spa has a heated lounge centred on a heated circular moonstone platform.
verified_facts.excerpt: A sculptural space centered around a heated circular moonstone platform.

verified_facts.text: Halcyon spa products include Sepai, APOEM and Ideal Form.
verified_facts.excerpt: include Sepai, APOEM, and Ideal Form® among others

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a light-filled waterfront gym open 24/7.
verified_facts.excerpt: the expansive, light-filled, waterfront, 24/7 gym

verified_facts.text: Cosmico is a rooftop pool club and restaurant with a Japanese-inspired menu, cocktails and DJ sessions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rooftop pool club & restaurant featuring Japanese-inspired menu, panoramic views, cocktails & DJ sessions.

verified_facts.text: Deluxe, in the lobby, changes from a café by day to a lounge bar at night.
verified_facts.excerpt: From morning to night, Deluxe transforms from a vibrant café to a sleek lounge bar.

verified_facts.text: Lora, off the lobby, serves cuisine inspired by the Mediterranean coast.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located off of the lobby, Lora takes you on a journey along the Mediterranean coast

verified_facts.text: Kyara is a post-modern cocktail bar on the hotel's fifth floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: A post-modern cocktail bar, hidden inside the 5th floor of SLS Barcelona.

verified_facts.text: Kyara is the first project in Spain from mixologists Monica Berg and Alex Kratena.
verified_facts.excerpt: The famous mixology duo Monica Berg and Alex Kratena have launched their first project in Spain

verified_facts.text: SLS Barcelona is the first European hotel from the SLS brand.
verified_facts.excerpt: The first European outpost from the SLS brand promises everything, and it delivers.

verified_facts.text: The building was designed by b720 Fermín Vázquez Arquitectos.
verified_facts.excerpt: the design by b720 Fermín Vázquez Arquitectos

verified_facts.text: A pink neon-lit hallway in the lobby leads to the port.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the lobby, your eyes will be drawn to the pink neon lights that illuminate what looks like a path guiding Alice to Wonderland (it actually leads to the port).

verified_facts.text: Monkeys are hidden throughout the hotel's decor, in paintings, decorative elements and lamps.
verified_facts.excerpt: Finding the monkeys hidden in the SLS Barcelona

verified_facts.text: The whole hotel was designed to be accessible to guests with limited mobility.
verified_facts.excerpt: All of the hotel was designed to be accessible to guests with limited mobility.

verified_facts.text: The hotel uses room keys made from recycled wood.
verified_facts.excerpt: using keys made from recycled wood
